description: Pick the border battlefield clean before the Libraries count the bodies.
success_text: Came back with a sack of scrap and only a slight limp.
failure_text: Came back with a sack. The sack is empty. The limp is not slight.

description: Walk a line of hymn-singing pilgrims to the Psalter Spires. Try not to learn the words.
success_text: The pilgrims arrived. One of them tipped in soul coins and a blessing.
failure_text: The convoy got rerouted by an Iron Choir muster. Walked 40 miles for nothing.

description: Carry a sealed crate to Driftmarket. Don't open it. Don't let anyone else open it.
success_text: Deal done. The crate was full of left shoes. Nobody asked why.
failure_text: Opened the crate. Regretted it. Came home empty-handed and quiet.

description: A depot quartermaster needs someone to not count some coffins.
success_text: Didn't count them. Very carefully. Got paid.
failure_text: Counted them by accident. Had to pretend to be drunk. Wasn't pretending.

description: Somebody bet somebody they wouldn't. Somebody will.
success_text: Remembers someone else's wedding now. Says it was nicer than theirs.
failure_text: Remembers someone else's tax audit now. Won't stop talking about it.

description: Haggle for Library salvage in the pyramid markets.
success_text: Came back with a wafer that hums and a story about a heretic with nice teeth.
failure_text: Got out-haggled by a child. The child was a Null Heretic. Probably.
